text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup—as the second leg of the 
Senior Autumn Triple Crown, attention 
surrounding Zenno Rob Roy was mounting.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
The weight of expectations is heavy. Yet, 
it is proof that she is forging ahead on a 
path to achieve what few ever can.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy's Heroic Tale
text_block_list.text:
To write a valiant heroic tale upon the 
turf, Zenno Rob Roy heads into the race.
